```{python} #| echo: false #| output: asis import csv, os from IPython.display import HTML, display CSV_PATH = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "publications.csv") # ── Tag colour mapping ────────────────────────────────────────── GREEN = {"Geospatial","Google Earth Engine","Soil Carbon","Coastal Agronomy", "Conservation Agriculture","Soil Health","Rice Farming","Soil Quality", "Agroforestry","Organic Farming","Agronomy","Oat Production", "Varietal Selection","Maize","Nutrient Management","Dryland Agriculture", "Maize Root Growth","Potassium","Zinc","Zinc Nutrition","Zinc Fertilization", "Silicon","Wheat Yield","Soil Fertility","Tillage","Conservation Tillage", "Rice Varieties","Phytochemicals","Rice-Wheat System","High-Altitude Agriculture", "PGPR","Sustainable Agriculture","Microbial Stimulants","Abiotic Stress", "Medicinal Crops","Moisture Stress","Microbial Synergy","Natural Farming", "Rice Pest","North-East India","Cotton","Sulphur Nutrition","Rainfed Agriculture", "Nutrient Quality","Crop Economics","Legumes","Green Technology","Cropping Patterns"} AMBER = {"Fodder Quality","Nitrate Toxicity","Fodder Oats","Livestock Systems", "Fodder Crops","Livestock Feed","Fodder Maize","Fodder Production", "Mycorrhizal Fungi","Forage Crops"} PURPLE = {"Bibliometrics","Computational Intelligence","Nanobionics", "Nanotechnology","Biofortification","Nutrition"} def tag_cls(t): t = t.strip() if t in GREEN: return "ptag-green" if t in AMBER: return "ptag-amber" if t in PURPLE: return "ptag-purple" return "ptag-blue" def make_tags(tags_str, sdg_str): h = "" for t in (tags_str or "").split("|"): t = t.strip() if t: h += f'{t}' for s in (sdg_str or "").split("|"): s = s.strip() if s: h += f'{s}' return h def pub_card(r): year = r.get("year","") ptype = r.get("type","journal").strip().capitalize() title = r.get("title","") journal = r.get("journal","") publisher = r.get("publisher","") authors = r.get("authors","") note = r.get("note","") link = r.get("link","").strip() doi = r.get("doi","").strip() meta = f'{journal}' if publisher: meta += f'·{publisher}' if authors: meta += f'·{authors}' note_h = f'
{note}
' if note else "" links_h = "" if link or doi: links_h = '
' if link: links_h += f'Read Paper' if doi: links_h += f'DOI' links_h += '
' return f"""
{year}
{ptype}
{title}
{meta}
{make_tags(r.get("tags",""), r.get("sdg_tags",""))}
{note_h}{links_h}
""" # ── Read CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── rows = [] if os.path.exists(CSV_PATH): with open(CSV_PATH, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f: rows = list(csv.DictReader(f)) journals = [r for r in rows if r.get("type","").strip().lower() == "journal"] chapters = [r for r in rows if r.get("type","").strip().lower() == "chapter"] # ── Build page HTML ───────────────────────────────────────────── parts = [] parts.append("""
Publications & Research Output
Research
60+
Papers
15+
Journals
324
Total Citations
9
h-index
2017–2026
Publication Span
""") parts.append(f"""
Journal Articles {len(journals)} Book Chapters {len(chapters)} PhD Thesis Ongoing Research
Tag colours:
Geospatial & Agronomy
Climate & Policy
Fodder & Livestock
Bibliometrics & Technology
SDG Alignment
""") # Journal Articles parts.append(f"""
Journal Articles
{len(journals)} papers
""") for r in journals: parts.append(pub_card(r)) # Book Chapters parts.append(f"""
Book Chapters
{len(chapters)} chapters
""") for r in chapters: parts.append(pub_card(r)) # PhD Thesis parts.append("""
PhD Thesis
2023
PhD
Performance of Wheat–Maize–Cowpea Cropping Sequence Under Continuous Use of Municipal Solid Waste Compost
ICAR – National Dairy Research Institute, Karnal, Haryana  ·  Doctoral Dissertation
Cropping Systems MSW Compost Soil Health Carbon Cycling SDG 2 SDG 12 SDG 15
Doctoral research examining how continuous application of municipal solid waste compost affects productivity and soil quality in wheat–maize–cowpea cropping sequences. Established foundational knowledge on organic waste recycling in agriculture — contributing to both soil health and circular economy goals.
""") # Ongoing Research parts.append("""
Ongoing Research
Geospatial assessment of coastal agricultural vulnerability using Google Earth Engine and multi-temporal remote sensing data
Soil health monitoring in rice-based cropping systems of coastal Goa — seasonal dynamics of biological and chemical indicators
Climate adaptation strategies for coastal farming communities in Goa — participatory assessment and policy framework development
""") display(HTML("\n".join(parts))) ```
